8.critic_justification: UserProfileSync.upsertCurrentUser writes Firebase User.email to Firestore users/{uid}.email (user_profile_sync.dart lines 17-22). That runs from DdayCloudSync.start (dday_cloud_sync.dart line 50), which AuthController starts on non-anonymous authStateChanges (auth_controller.dart lines 149-152) and from ensureAnonymous when a session already exists (lines 181-186). initialize() also calls _restoreGoogleAccount (lines 163-164), which uses GoogleSignIn.signInSilently and _linkFirebase (lines 407-412 and 292) and then upserts the profile. main.dart starts AuthController.initialize() with no consent step. LegalScreen is a settings-only document (legal_screen.dart; opened from settings_screen.dart) with no Accept control, so it does not gate the upload. The privacy-policy text does mention email (legal_copy.dart lines 108-109 and 237-238), but that is not an in-app gate. Firestore is the developer project (first-party). Anonymous sessions have a null email, but the Google-linked and silent-restore paths do send the address and tie it to the uid.
8.issue_summary: Google account email is written to first-party Firestore users/{uid}.email without an in-app consent gate. UserProfileSync.upsertCurrentUser runs from DdayCloudSync.start on session restore and from silent Google restore (signInSilently then _linkFirebase) inside AuthController.initialize, before the user can open LegalScreen. The privacy policy mentions the email address, but LegalScreen is a settings document with no Accept control and does not run before the upload.

14.critic_justification: AndroidManifest.xml lines 7-8 declare both SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM and USE_EXACT_ALARM. MorningFortuneAlarm.arm uses AlarmManager.setExactAndAllowWhileIdle on API 23+ and setExact otherwise (MorningFortuneAlarm.kt lines 92-96) so MorningFortuneReceiver can post the daily_encouragement channel (lines 122-133, description about fortune at 8:00 and an afternoon encouragement). The launcher is MainActivity with widget and dearly://invite filters, not an alarm-clock, timer, or calendar handler. applicationId is com.dearly.quoteswidget (android/app/build.gradle.kts); com.quotation.quotation is only the namespace. DailyWordWidgetProvider.scheduleHourlyRefresh already uses setInexactRepeating (DailyWordWidgetProvider.kt lines 430-440). A quotes/widget companion scheduling a local encouragement is outside the USE_EXACT_ALARM core-functionality categories.
14.issue_summary: USE_EXACT_ALARM is not justified. The app is a quotation companion (applicationId com.dearly.quoteswidget, namespace com.quotation.quotation, launcher MainActivity) whose exact alarm only posts a local daily encouragement notification, not an alarm clock, timer, or calendar.

15.critic_justification: Settings shows a Login button that calls authController.signIn() (settings_screen.dart lines 37-39 and 158-164). signIn() uses GoogleSignIn with email and profile scopes and GoogleAuthConfig.serverClientId (auth_controller.dart lines 128-134 and 203-223). _linkFirebase exchanges the Google credential with Firebase Auth and calls UserProfileSync.upsertCurrentUser (lines 258-292). google_auth_config.dart lines 9-14 hold the OAuth server client id. ensureAnonymous also signs in anonymously (auth_controller.dart lines 181-192), so Google login is optional and the app opens without reviewer credentials. account_deletion_screen.dart lines 14-15 already define https://doyun0327.github.io/quotation/delete-account.html. Play Console submission of demo credentials and that URL cannot be confirmed from source, so this is a console checklist item rather than a demonstrated in-app omission.
15.issue_summary: Settings includes an optional Google sign-in path backed by Firebase Auth. Anonymous sign-in already opens the app, so reviewers are not blocked, but Play Console App access still needs a demo Google account if the signed-in path must be reviewed. A public deletion URL is already implemented in the app and still has to be submitted in Play Console.
15.recommendation: In Play Console App access, add a non-expiring Google demo account only if review must exercise the optional Google-linked path. Submit the existing page https://doyun0327.github.io/quotation/delete-account.html from account_deletion_screen.dart as the public account-deletion URL.
